parsed.note_claim: The story that Hakimi transferred all assets to his mother's name to avoid divorce division is false fake news.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: there is no evidence supporting the claim that Hakimi has registered a larger chunk of his property in his mother's name to prevent his wife from acquiring a portion of the property after the divorce.
parsed.reason: The fact-check article explicitly declares the claim false and states there is no evidence for the asset transfer allegation.
